messages:
harper: Brief postmortem posted. Root cause: provider control-plane instability caused bursty 401/429 responses from the auth service; our model-registry clients attempted aggressive refreshes and amplified the outage. Need follow-ups on client throttling, registry fallback, observability, vendor SLA, and deploy gates.

mohit: I can take client throttling defaults and a small compatibility test across SDKs. Plan: default backoff base=0.5s, max=12s, max_retries=4, and jitter. Will open a PR.

anya: I will own registry fallback: implement read-only replica promotion and a quick-consistency note. Will prototype a mirror with best-effort replication and document tradeoffs.

tess: Ops update: opened vendor ticket #CP-512; vendor believes a recent control-plane config rollout caused token issuance delays. Asked for interim mitigation and SLA clarification.

infra-bot: Scheduled action: canary deploy of client throttle PR set for 2026-04-01T01:00:00Z. Oncall will be pinged at start.

harper: Action item list: mohit - throttle PR (due 2026-03-29), anya - mirror doc + failover PoC (due 2026-03-31), tess - vendor SLA confirmation & escalation (due 2026-03-27), harper - runbook and incident writeup (due 2026-03-28). I will file these on the incident board.

mohit: Example config I'll add to the PR:
```
CLIENT_THROTTLE = {
  "base_sec": 0.5,
  "max_sec": 12,
  "max_retries": 4,
  "jitter": true
}
```

anya: Mirror sketch: async replicate on write, secondary read for degraded mode. Will include verification that no tokens are persisted and encryption in transit.

tess: Vendor update: vendor acknowledged wide-area control-plane instability and assigned an incident. They offered a post-incident RCA by 2026-04-03 and a follow-up on SLA credits.

harper: Monitoring changes: add alert for auth_401_rate > 0.2% for 3m, auth_429_rate > 0.5% for 5m, and registry_replication_lag > 5s. Add synthetic auth check every 2m.

mohit: Note: also suggest a short-term mitigation in SDKs to stop immediate full-token-refresh on 401 if a recent refresh occurred (dedupe refreshes for 30s).

anya: I'll add chaos test that injects intermittent 429s for the auth endpoint and validate registry fallback and no data loss.

harper: Recurrence plan: monthly vendor rollout audit and a deploy gate for auth-provider config changes. Also add a weekly dashboard that correlates token refresh rates with deploy times.

tess: Sync: quick check-in Friday 9:30am PT to confirm PR + PoC statuses.

mohit: +1

anya: +1

harper: Thanks all, please link PRs/tickets in the incident follow-up doc; I'll mark items resolved when PRs merged and PoC validated.
